context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 verified: 1) Dashboard stats now include events (total + by_type) and invitations (total, attended, declined, no_answer, pending, by_type) with bar chart visualization. 2) Package CRUD now supports invitation_count field - displayed as badges on package cards (e.g., '12 dəvət'). 3) Obligation quota is read dynamically from packages collection via get_package_quotas() function. 4) Obligation History page has comprehensive filters: event type dropdown, status dropdown (Qatıldı/Rədd etdi/Cavab vermədi/Gözləyir), date range (from/to), and search. Summary section shows per-event-type stats. Test data: 5 Breakfast events, 12 invitations with various statuses. Default package quotas: Premium=12, Business=15, Business Plus=25, Sponsor=40.

dashboard_events_stats.details: Dashboard shows 'Fəaliyyət statistikası' card with total events count and breakdown by event type. API returns events.total and events.by_type array.

dashboard_invitations_stats.details: Dashboard shows 'Dəvət statistikası' card with total invitations, attended, declined, no_answer counts and bar chart. API returns invitations.total, attended, declined, no_answer, pending, by_type.

package_invitation_count.details: Settings packages page has 'Dəvət sayı' input field. Package CRUD saves/updates invitation_count. Package cards display badges like '12 dəvət'.

dynamic_quota_reading.details: Obligation quota is read dynamically from packages collection. get_package_quotas() function reads invitation_count from packages, falls back to DEFAULT_PACKAGE_QUOTAS.

obligation_history_filters.details: Obligation History page has: event type filter (Bütün növlər + all event types), status filter (Hamısı/Qatıldı/Rədd etdi/Cavab vermədi/Gözləyir), date range filters (from/to), search input.

obligation_history_summary.details: Obligation History shows 'Fəaliyyət növləri üzrə hesabat' summary section with per-type stats: Görüş sayı, Dəvət, Qatıldı, Rədd, Cavabsız.

obligation_history_table.details: Detailed invitations table with columns: #, Şirkət, Fəaliyyət, Növ, Tarix, Status, Zəng edən. Shows 'Dəvət tarixçəsi (X nəticə)' header.
